sources.title: The original field report
sources.content: Our controlled pilot included twelve volunteers using a document assistant over one week. Participants completed fewer repeated searches when the assistant linked each answer to the original paragraph. The pilot did not measure long term retention, commercial revenue, or performance outside this small group. Further testing with larger samples is needed before drawing broad conclusions.

sources.title: An independently worded critique
sources.content: Twelve participants and seven days cannot establish that a product improves professional research in general. A useful next experiment would separate interface improvements from model quality and repeat the task with independent evaluators. The source deserves credit for its caveats: https://lab.example/report

sources.title: An unrelated source for comparison
sources.content: Healthy soil supports roots through drainage and organic matter. Gardeners can compare beds by checking moisture at consistent depths throughout the growing season. Shade, rainfall, and local climate matter more than a universal watering schedule.
